coordinate_system: Raw retained source line numbers, not web-view line coordinates. Historical BaseCache/Clocked have documented trailing EOF whitespace differences only.

events.mapping: Previous/current synchronous hit decision in BaseCache::recvTimingReq -> access; no simulation event is advanced by the ordinary call sequence.
events.guards: ordinary cacheable read, valid readable ready block, no exceptional path
events.receiver_premise: Hit cancellation at this decision is a declared WU receiver assumption, absent from this public BaseCache.

events.mapping: access chooses lat; request_time=clockEdge(lat) then hit path calls schedTimingResp(pkt,request_time).
events.guards: fixed period p, zero header/clock phase, sequential tag/data, no compression, ready block; selected latency ell cycles
events.execution: source argument; ctarget equation is declared in the response stub, not a test of cache conformance

events.mapping: PacketQueue sends at max(target,curTick+1). With exclusive empty queue, one outstanding request, c>s+1 and accepting response port, eta=c.
events.guards: no other queue traffic, no response backpressure; p>=2,ell>=1 imply c>=s+2
events.execution: queue source argument; only MemTest response callback executes

events.mapping: MemTest interval q: response before s+q keeps scheduled h=s+q; poll before response sets waitResponse and callback schedules h=c+q. Reached c=s+q is rejected before execution.
events.guards: client clock one tick, command0 cacheable nonfunctional read, one address/block/outstanding, no retry, maxLoads0, sufficient watchdog
events.execution: Five public definitions included and compiled; positive request/callback paths exercise tick/sendPkt/recvTimingResp/completeRequest. recvRetry is retained but outside positive no-retry coverage. No instrumented function-coverage claim. Cache/queue/receiver functions do not execute.

identity: chi denotes the identity linking one dynamic completion to its cancelling service and valid block; it is not the timestamp value. An epoch/identity mismatch prevents use; unequal dynamic identities must not be joined.
boundary_choice: Producer retains the reachable relation proof and returns a chosen-period/identity/epoch/horizon-bound witness result with represented and joint-witness completion residues. Consumer checks equality before using the completion-only actual-slack query. This is a trusted timing contract, not independent reachability verification from a Boolean. Period changes recheck witnesses or re-bucket profile/history. Exact loop-term accounting is not a measured cost saving.
scope: No native queue/cache/receiver execution. Mixed path results are source-function/stub/component checks. No whole-program, hardware, performance, area, energy or workload-prevalence claim.
